title: Mi Video-Short Video Download
summary: An online short video, local video player, downloader, and file manager
description:
Mi Video is a powerful local video player and downloader preferred by millions of users. With Mi Video, you can play, download, stream, and manage your videos all in one place.

New Features:
Online Short Videos
Open Moment and you can:
Immerse yourself in scrolling through videos for a more enjoyable and relaxed viewing experience
Continuously updated with popular content such as life records, food, comedy, music, and inspiration
Continuously watch what you like, or swipe away if you don't
Directly save or download your favorite short videos for easy viewing and sharing
Personalized Intelligent Recommendations
Mi Video continuously learns your interests based on your viewing behavior:
Automatically recommend video content you might like
Discover new videos without searching
Every time you open it, it's a content stream customized for you
Easy Decompression Moments
Whether you're commuting, relaxing before bed, or waiting in line:
Easy and fun video content accompanies you anytime, making happiness simpler
Download and save for offline viewing
Want to save your favorite videos to your device and watch them later? Mi Video supports high-speed downloads.

High requirements for the video player? Don't worry, we're exactly the video player you need, an amazing video player for your phone and pad with an attractive user Interface and powerful play functions such as background play function, pop-up play function. High requirements for the video downloader? Endless trending videos from Instagram, Likee, Facebook, Tumblr, Snapchat, TikTok. Enjoy fun content anytime and anywhere, and share them to WhatsApp, Telegram, and VK.

Looking for a perfect video player? Mi Video is committed to creating an excellent video player and providing high-quality playback experience  for users of all mobile phone brands such as Samsung, Motorola, Huawei, OPPO, vivo and so on!

Video player
- Mi Video supports all major video file formats, including MKV, MP4, M4V, MOV, AVI, and more.
- Background playback is convenient and full-featured:
You can double tap the screen to pause or resume playback.
Smart gesture controls allow you to adjust volume, brightness, or playback progress in a simple and intuitive way.
You can easily zoom in and out on the played videos.
- Subtitles are available in multiple languages.

Free video downloader
- Want to save online videos on your device and watch them later? Mi Video can download videos from all major social media platforms.
- Downloading videos seems too complicated? Our new interface makes video downloads simple and trouble-free.
- Use the "Help" section of our app to learn how you can download videos.
- Mi Video supports downloading multiple videos at the same time. You can also select your preferred resolution!

Online streaming
- Mi Video offers a huge online streaming library: pranks, games, sports, news - you'll always find something to your taste.
- When you don't know what to watch next, you can always check out our selection of the videos trending around the world or dive into built-in Facebook Watch feed.

File manager
- All-new design allows you to find the videos you need in no time.
- Create password-protected folders to store videos intended for your eyes only.

We keep updating Mi Video to make video playback, downloading, and file management even more convenient. 

Mi Video is a perfect way to enjoy your videos. If you like Mi Video, give us some stars! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

If you have any questions, feel free to drop us a line at mivideo-feedback@xiaomi.com or use the in-app feedback channel. Your feedback helps us make Mi Video better!

We've added some new features to make your viewing experience even better:
Powerful zoom is right at your fingertips. Mi Video supports 25%-500% zoom.
Search online for subtitles, even for local videos. Select the language you need, hassle-free.
Choose between 16:9 or 4:3 aspect ratios.
